assay: bulk mRNA-seq (paired-end, Illumina NovaSeq 6000), mouse gastrocnemius muscle (S2.7.p1)
design_in_paper: 4 groups randomized at 4 weeks of age, n=12/group: chow (C), chow+MICT (CM), HFD (H), HFD+MICT (HM); HFD weeks 1-21; MICT treadmill weeks 14-21, 45 min/day, 5 d/wk (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1). RNA-seq on n=6/group for C, H, HM only; CM was not sequenced (S2.7.p1, S3.2.p1, FIG3).
sample_inclusion: 18 GSMs = C1-6, H1-6, HM1-6; no exclusions stated
primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week MICT on gastrocnemius gene expression in HFD-fed mice: HM vs H (exercise effect under HFD; S3.2.p1, S4.p7-p9). H vs C is the diet (non-exercise) effect reported alongside.
planned_contrasts: HM vs H (S3.2.p1; paper: 563 DEGs, 213 up / 350 down) - exercise contrast
H vs C (S3.2.p1; paper: 458 DEGs, 295 up / 163 down) - diet contrast, not exercise
repeated_measure_unit: none; one sample per mouse, independent animals
normalization: DESeq2 median-of-ratios on featureCounts raw counts (S2.7.p1)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.22.2 on raw counts, BH FDR (S2.7.p1); model scope (all samples vs pairwise subsets) not stated
paper_results: Table 1/2 top-50 DEGs; MICT downregulates Foxo1, Fbxo32, Trim63, Txnip, Pdk4, Angptl4; minimal change in Pax7, Myod1, Myog (S3.5.p1, S4.p8)
